package.name: reflective_pose_autoware
package.description:
Autoware handoff for the reflective board detector: gates on VelocityReport, spends the attempt budget, applies the fallback policy, and calls autoware_localization_msgs/InitializeLocalization.
This is the only package in the repository that depends on Autoware, and it is the reason the other four do not. Anything added here that does not need an Autoware type belongs in reflective_pose_ros or reflective_pose_core.
